summary: Draft is generally sound in word splitting and most morphology, but has real errors: saṃyataḥ (u2), pāthaḥ genitive (u4), spurious apā -> apa+ā split (u7), mistranslated śatinam and added simile (u9), citayema 'shine' (u10), yam/yajñam construal and Hindi/English mismatch (u11), and 'Heaven and Earth' read into janasī (u4). Recurring minor fault: bracketed supplied words in the Hindi and English throughout. No regrouping suggested. Glossary additions proposed: adhvara = rite (अध्वर); brahman = prayer (ब्रह्मन्); rodasī = the two worlds; sūri = patron (दानी); vidatha = assembly (सभा); vṛjana = enclosure (one rendering throughout); arati = servant; Jātavedas = Jātavedas (जातवेदा); caus. √cit = make known.
